controls.title: Logical access provisioning and least privilege
controls.statement: Logical access to systems and tenant data is granted through an authorized request, provisioned on the principle of least privilege, and recertified periodically; access rights are matched to a documented role rather than granted ad hoc.

evidence.title: Tenant isolation enforced by FORCE row-level security
evidence.summary: all 5 tenant tables enforce FORCE row-level security

controls.title: Immutable, hash-chained audit log
controls.statement: Security-relevant events are written to an append-only, hash-chained log that cannot be altered or deleted after the fact; integrity is verifiable against a trusted anchor so tampering, truncation, or rewriting is detectable.

evidence.title: Append-only audit chain integrity (WORM-anchored)
evidence.summary: audit chain verified against its anchor (1 entries)

controls.title: Secure retention and disposal of confidential data
controls.statement: Confidential data is retained only as long as required and then disposed of so that it is rendered unrecoverable; for encrypted data, destruction of the governing key (crypto-shred) is an accepted disposal mechanism.

evidence.title: WORM retention meets the legal floor
evidence.summary: WORM retention until 2033-06-27T12:00:00.000Z meets the floor (2032-06-27T12:00:00.000Z)

summary.posture: 3 of 3 controls evidence-ready; no gaps recorded.
